blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two bank accounts belonging to a banana chips company partly owned by Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband, Atty. Manases Carpio, were closed in July 2026, the same month her impeachment trial began, the Senate Impeachment Court learned on Wednesday. During Senator-judge Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan’s questioning, prosecution witness and Security Bank Branch Banking Group Head Leslie Cham confirmed that Calle88 Foods Corp. had two peso-denominated checking accounts with the bank, both of which were closed in July 2026. The first account, ending in 2013, was opened in August 2024 and had an ending balance of P332,530.95 in 2024 and […]...
